verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean states only the right-hand member of the paper's two-step chain, and in cleared form |N_s| ≤ C|η|(1+y)E² rather than |N_s|/E² ≤ C|η|(1+y); the two are the same inequality because E = angular P dropLength lam (y,η) > 0 (angular_pos, OutgoingSchedule.lean:159). The intermediate member C|η|(e^{T_d}/P_*² + 1 + y) is nowhere stated; in its place the hypothesis exp(dropLength+1) ≤ P² (the paper's P_* > e^{T_d}) is used inside the proof, at line 990, to get E² ≥ 1/4 and absorb the geometric part — the same mechanism as the paper's first step, so the bound the later argument uses is the one proved. C is the explicit axialBound = 259 + 4·pressureBound, depending only on the previously fixed pressure envelope; the range is 0 ≤ y ≤ T_d + 1 and |η| ≤ 1. The identification of the Lean axialLag with the paper's N_s is canonical_Ns_before.
